question: Show the raw forecast variance by region for Hydration Sunscreen during the signal window.
query:
ForecastActualDaily
| where productId == "PROD-HS-100"
| where timestamp between (datetime(2026-06-22) .. datetime(2026-08-02))
| summarize forecastUnits = sum(forecastUnits), actualUnits = sum(actualUnits), avgVariancePct = round(avg(variancePct), 1) by regionId, signalAffected
| order by signalAffected desc, avgVariancePct desc

question: What raw climate-signal observations support SIG-ENSO-2026-07?
query:
ClimateSignalObservations
| where signalId == "SIG-ENSO-2026-07"
| summarize avgSeaSurfaceAnomalyC = round(avg(seaSurfaceAnomalyC), 2), avgUvIndex = round(avg(uvIndex), 2), avgAnomalyVsBaselineC = round(avg(anomalyVsBaselineC), 2), provenance = take_any(provenance) by regionId
| order by avgAnomalyVsBaselineC desc

question: On decision day, does the 30-day weather forecast still show elevated UV and temperature in affected regions?
query:
WeatherForecastDaily
| where issueDate == datetime(2026-08-03)
| where regionId in ("REG-COASTAL", "REG-SOUTH", "REG-DELTA", "REG-ISLAND", "REG-NORTH", "REG-CENTRAL")
| summarize horizonStart = min(targetDate), horizonEnd = max(targetDate), meanUvIndexAnomalyP50 = round(avg(uvIndexAnomaly_p50), 2), meanTemperatureAnomalyCP50 = round(avg(temperatureMeanAnomalyC_p50), 2), avgConfidence = round(avg(confidence), 2), provenance = take_any(provenance) by regionId
| order by meanUvIndexAnomalyP50 desc

question: What line telemetry supports the reduced-rate higher-utilisation production plan?
query:
LineSignals
| where lineId == "PKG-02"
| where timestamp between (datetime(2026-08-17) .. datetime(2026-10-04))
| summarize avgRateFactor = round(avg(rateFactor), 2), avgUtilisation = round(avg(utilisation), 2), maxCumulativeStressIndex = round(max(cumulativeStressIndex), 2), producingSamples = countif(producing) by state
| order by state asc
